verdict.rationale: GrowthBook offers a free cloud signup with no credit card, a quickstart that claims setup in minutes, and per-environment flag enable/disable plus a toggle endpoint. A user reports a working flag in about 15 minutes, and a hands-on probe created a flag and saw it served by the SDK endpoint. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of toggling the flag specifically in a production environment and watching the change propagate live (the probe only covered create-and-evaluate).

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Get GrowthBook running in your application in minutes.
Feature flags can be enabled and disabled on a per-environment basis.
the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
We had Growthbook working in roughly 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code changed.
a real flag create-and-evaluate loop with no account or license.
